title: Cup-ring experiment: scoring rubric for consistency check and viewer test
purpose: Converts Scout's inspection_sheet.md and Iris's viewer questions into a fillable scoring table. Consistency check must pass (all ΔRGB ≤ 10, ring position ≤ 5 px) before transition comparison is run. Viewer responses are captured as categorical codes so results from multiple viewers can be tabulated without prose interpretation. Works alongside artifact 2bb3e31d-4098-4e87-8793-932329678ac2.
